svg.aria-label: Map of Democratic Republic of the Congo
svg.metadata: Target and surrounding national geometry: Natural Earth 1:10m cultural vectors, WGS84, public domain, via LonnyGomes/CountryGeoJSONCollection commit 5120290da88f3f205f74aa55f3c8fa1f19d1bc8b. Immediate neighbours plus second-ring context countries are rendered so aspect-fit sidebands show real land rather than default sea; Ethiopia added to complete the northeast viewport. Uncovered background remains actual open water. JOURNEY ATLAS map-v3 clean-background styling; corrected 2026-09-29.
